import bpy
import math
import random
import os

# Clear scene
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

# Scene settings
scene = bpy.context.scene
try:
    scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'
except:
    try:
        scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE'
    except:
        scene.render.engine = 'CYCLES'

scene.render.resolution_x = 1920
scene.render.resolution_y = 1080
scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
scene.render.fps = 24
scene.frame_start = 1
scene.frame_end = 240

# Add a camera (isometric)
bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(25, -25, 25))
cam = bpy.context.active_object
cam.rotation_euler = (math.radians(54.736), 0, math.radians(45))
cam.data.type = 'ORTHO'
cam.data.ortho_scale = 15
scene.camera = cam

# Environment/Lighting (Sunset)
world = scene.world
if world is None:
    world = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
    scene.world = world
world.use_nodes = True
bg = world.node_tree.nodes['Background']
bg.inputs[0].default_value = (0.9, 0.4, 0.3, 1) # Sunset sky color
bg.inputs[1].default_value = 1.0

# Add Sun Light
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN', location=(10, -10, 10))
sun = bpy.context.active_object
sun.rotation_euler = (math.radians(45), math.radians(0), math.radians(45))
sun.data.energy = 4.0
sun.data.color = (1.0, 0.8, 0.5)
sun.data.angle = math.radians(10) # Soft shadows

# Add Fill Light (Blueish from sky)
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN', location=(-10, 10, 10))
fill = bpy.context.active_object
fill.rotation_euler = (math.radians(45), math.radians(0), math.radians(225))
fill.data.energy = 1.0
fill.data.color = (0.2, 0.4, 0.8)
fill.data.angle = math.radians(20)

# Add rim light (pinkish)
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN', location=(10, 10, 10))
rim = bpy.context.active_object
rim.rotation_euler = (math.radians(45), math.radians(0), math.radians(135))
rim.data.energy = 1.5
rim.data.color = (0.9, 0.3, 0.6)
rim.data.angle = math.radians(15)

# Materials
def create_material(name, color):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = color
    bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.9
    bsdf.inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value = 0.1
    return mat

mat_island = create_material("Island", (0.2, 0.6, 0.4, 1.0))
mat_water = create_material("Water", (0.1, 0.4, 0.9, 1.0))
mat_stone = create_material("Stone", (0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1.0))
mat_char_body_1 = create_material("CharBody1", (0.9, 0.2, 0.3, 1.0))
mat_char_body_2 = create_material("CharBody2", (0.2, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0))
mat_char_body_3 = create_material("CharBody3", (0.9, 0.7, 0.2, 1.0))
mat_char_head = create_material("CharHead", (1.0, 0.9, 0.8, 1.0))

# Create Floating Island / Stepping Stones
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0, 0, -1))
island = bpy.context.active_object
island.scale = (12, 12, 2)
island.data.materials.append(mat_island)
bpy.ops.object.modifier_add(type='BEVEL')
island.modifiers["Bevel"].width = 0.1
island.modifiers["Bevel"].segments = 3

# Stepping stones
for i in range(10):
    loc_x = random.uniform(-5, 5)
    loc_y = random.uniform(-5, 5)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(loc_x, loc_y, 0.1))
    stone = bpy.context.active_object
    stone.scale = (random.uniform(0.5, 2.0), random.uniform(0.5, 2.0), 0.2)
    stone.data.materials.append(mat_stone)
    bpy.ops.object.modifier_add(type='BEVEL')
    stone.modifiers["Bevel"].width = 0.05
    stone.modifiers["Bevel"].segments = 3

# Water base (floating lower)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0, 0, -2))
water = bpy.context.active_object
water.scale = (14, 14, 0.5)
water.data.materials.append(mat_water)

# Helper to create beveled boxes
def create_box(name, size, location, parent=None, material=None, pivot='CENTER'):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1)
    obj = bpy.context.active_object
    obj.name = name
    
    if pivot == 'BOTTOM':
        for v in obj.data.vertices: v.co.z += 0.5
    elif pivot == 'TOP':
        for v in obj.data.vertices: v.co.z -= 0.5
        
    obj.scale = size
    if parent:
        obj.parent = parent
    
    # Apply location in local space if parented
    obj.location = location
    
    if material:
        obj.data.materials.append(material)
    bpy.ops.object.modifier_add(type='BEVEL')
    obj.modifiers["Bevel"].width = 0.02
    obj.modifiers["Bevel"].segments = 2
    return obj

# Create character hierarchy
def create_character(name_prefix, location, mat_body):
    # Empty root
    bpy.ops.object.empty_add(type='PLAIN_AXES', location=location)
    root = bpy.context.active_object
    root.name = name_prefix + "_Root"
    
    # Body
    body = create_box(name_prefix + "_Body", (0.6, 0.4, 0.8), (0, 0, 0.8), parent=root, material=mat_body, pivot='BOTTOM')
    
    # Head
    head = create_box(name_prefix + "_Head", (0.5, 0.5, 0.5), (0, 0, 0.9), parent=body, material=mat_char_head, pivot='BOTTOM')
    
    # Legs (Left, Right)
    leg_l = create_box(name_prefix + "_LegL", (0.2, 0.2, 0.6), (-0.2, 0, 0.8), parent=root, material=mat_body, pivot='TOP')
    leg_r = create_box(name_prefix + "_LegR", (0.2, 0.2, 0.6), (0.2, 0, 0.8), parent=root, material=mat_body, pivot='TOP')
    
    # Arms (Left, Right)
    arm_l = create_box(name_prefix + "_ArmL", (0.15, 0.15, 0.6), (-0.4, 0, 0.7), parent=body, material=mat_body, pivot='TOP')
    arm_r = create_box(name_prefix + "_ArmR", (0.15, 0.15, 0.6), (0.4, 0, 0.7), parent=body, material=mat_body, pivot='TOP')
    
    # Hands / Blocky Fingers (Just a couple of small blocks)
    hand_l = create_box(name_prefix + "_HandL", (0.15, 0.15, 0.2), (0, 0, -0.6), parent=arm_l, material=mat_char_head, pivot='TOP')
    hand_r = create_box(name_prefix + "_HandR", (0.15, 0.15, 0.2), (0, 0, -0.6), parent=arm_r, material=mat_char_head, pivot='TOP')
    
    # Finger stubs
    finger1_l = create_box(name_prefix + "_Finger1L", (0.05, 0.15, 0.1), (-0.05, 0, -0.2), parent=hand_l, material=mat_char_head, pivot='TOP')
    finger2_l = create_box(name_prefix + "_Finger2L", (0.05, 0.15, 0.1), (0.05, 0, -0.2), parent=hand_l, material=mat_char_head, pivot='TOP')
    
    finger1_r = create_box(name_prefix + "_Finger1R", (0.05, 0.15, 0.1), (-0.05, 0, -0.2), parent=hand_r, material=mat_char_head, pivot='TOP')
    finger2_r = create_box(name_prefix + "_Finger2R", (0.05, 0.15, 0.1), (0.05, 0, -0.2), parent=hand_r, material=mat_char_head, pivot='TOP')
    
    return root, body, head, leg_l, leg_r, arm_l, arm_r

char1, b1, h1, ll1, lr1, al1, ar1 = create_character("Char1", (0, 0, 0), mat_char_body_1)
char2, b2, h2, ll2, lr2, al2, ar2 = create_character("Char2", (2, 2, 0), mat_char_body_2)
char3, b3, h3, ll3, lr3, al3, ar3 = create_character("Char3", (-2, 1, 0), mat_char_body_3)

chars = [(char1, b1, h1, ll1, lr1, al1, ar1), 
         (char2, b2, h2, ll2, lr2, al2, ar2),
         (char3, b3, h3, ll3, lr3, al3, ar3)]

# Animate characters walking and looking
for c_idx, (root, body, head, leg_l, leg_r, arm_l, arm_r) in enumerate(chars):
    # Walk cycle parameters
    start_pos = root.location.copy()
    speed = 0.04
    direction = random.uniform(0, math.pi*2)
    dx = math.cos(direction) * speed
    dy = math.sin(direction) * speed
    
    root.rotation_euler = (0, 0, direction + math.pi/2)
    root.keyframe_insert(data_path="rotation_euler", frame=1)
    
    for frame in range(1, 241):
        # Move forward (staying within island bounds roughly)
        new_x = root.location.x + dx
        new_y = root.location.y + dy
        if abs(new_x) > 4 or abs(new_y) > 4:
            # Turn around
            direction += math.pi + random.uniform(-0.5, 0.5)
            dx = math.cos(direction) * speed
            dy = math.sin(direction) * speed
            root.rotation_euler = (0, 0, direction + math.pi/2)
            root.keyframe_insert(data_path="rotation_euler", frame=frame)
            new_x = root.location.x + dx
            new_y = root.location.y + dy
        
        root.location.x = new_x
        root.location.y = new_y
        
        # Change direction slightly and randomly
        if frame % 40 == 0:
            direction += random.uniform(-0.5, 0.5)
            dx = math.cos(direction) * speed
            dy = math.sin(direction) * speed
            root.rotation_euler = (0, 0, direction + math.pi/2)
            root.keyframe_insert(data_path="rotation_euler", frame=frame)
            
        root.keyframe_insert(data_path="location", frame=frame)
        
        # Bobbing body
        body.location.z = 0.8 + abs(math.sin(frame * 0.3)) * 0.1
        body.keyframe_insert(data_path="location", frame=frame)
        
        # Looking around (Head rotation)
        if frame % 30 == 0:
            head.rotation_euler.z = random.uniform(-0.6, 0.6)
            head.rotation_euler.x = random.uniform(-0.2, 0.2)
            head.keyframe_insert(data_path="rotation_euler", frame=frame)
            
        # Legs walking (rotation)
        leg_l.rotation_euler.x = math.sin(frame * 0.3) * 0.6
        leg_r.rotation_euler.x = -math.sin(frame * 0.3) * 0.6
        leg_l.keyframe_insert(data_path="rotation_euler", frame=frame)
        leg_r.keyframe_insert(data_path="rotation_euler", frame=frame)
        
        # Arms swinging (rotation)
        arm_l.rotation_euler.x = -math.sin(frame * 0.3) * 0.4
        arm_r.rotation_euler.x = math.sin(frame * 0.3) * 0.4
        arm_l.keyframe_insert(data_path="rotation_euler", frame=frame)
        arm_r.keyframe_insert(data_path="rotation_euler", frame=frame)

# Save .blend file
blend_path = "C:/Users/renu5/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/scene.blend"
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=blend_path)
args.Description: Python script to generate Blender 3D scene and animation
